title: Phase 1 Consolidation — AGENT-EXTRACTION: Promote agents from SDM Files to standalone
spec:
CONSOLIDATION ACTION: AGENT-EXTRACTION

Agents that are functional should be standalone projects. SDM Files utility scripts stay.

TASK 1: Verify agent self-containment
Check these agents in the master folder and confirm each has README, requirements.txt, and can run independently:
- agents/status-report-agent/
- agents/communication-agent/
- bots/mgm-status-bot/
- bots/dd-status-bot/

For each, report:
- Has README? Y/N
- Has requirements.txt or package.json? Y/N
- Has entry point script? Y/N
- Self-contained (no imports from parent SDM Files)? Y/N

TASK 2: Fix any gaps
For agents missing README or requirements.txt:
- Create a minimal README.md with: purpose, setup instructions, usage
- Create requirements.txt from imports if missing
- Do NOT change working code

TASK 3: Verify SDM Files utilities
Check sdm-files/ for remaining utility scripts:
- webex_bot.py, webex_bot_server.py
- generate_mgm_pptx.py
- subscribers.json handling
- Service Delivery Manager Agentic Framework docs

Confirm these are correctly categorized as utilities (not standalone agents).

TASK 4: Update MASTER_INDEX.md
- Ensure all agents have accurate status and descriptions
- Add missing README paths if created in Task 2

TASK 5: Report
- List each agent with self-containment status
- List any fixes applied
- Confirm sdm-files/ utility classification

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT move files between directories — just verify and fix gaps
- Create only README.md and requirements.txt where missing
- No code changes to working scripts
